title: Fintech Loan Management Platform
description: Large-scale, production loan management platform enabling over 11B ETB in disbursement across multiple banks, NGOs, and financial institutions. Sole developer on the platform since taking over from the previous lead, owning backend services, frontend, and system architecture end to end — designing and building microservices including an activity log service and a notification service within an event-driven architecture spanning Go, Node.js, Kafka, Redis, and PostgreSQL. Delivered system integration across external banking systems and internal services to keep data accurate and consistent under production load, and improved platform reliability and performance through architectural refinement, debugging, and enhancement of live services. Alongside development, I run production operations directly — system monitoring, incident handling, and database operations — holding direct responsibility for uptime and data integrity on live financial workflows, while translating stakeholder and client requirements into platform design.
